grades: Book reviews: grades 7-12. Teen Advisory Board: high school students.
name: Teen Volunteering and Teen Advisory Board (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: Earn community service hours at the library through Teen Volunteer Time, the Teen Advisory Board (plan teen programs and shape the collection), or by writing book reviews.
who_can_apply: Teens. Book reviews are for grades 7 to 12. The Teen Advisory Board is for high school students and requires a Library Services Orientation for Teens first. OG reading tutoring is for ages 16 and up.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Community service hours (1 hour per book review, up to 5 reviews a month).
duration: Teen Volunteer Time: Thursdays 4:15 PM at Central Library (or Saturdays 11 AM to 12:30 PM at Eastside Library). Advisory Board: 2 Tuesday meetings a month, 5-6:30 PM, in the school year.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board applications are taken at the start of each school term. Teen Volunteer Time and book reviews are ongoing.
how_to_apply: Teen Volunteer Time: pre-register to guarantee a spot, or drop in. Advisory Board: submit the application and attend the orientation. Book reviews: submit through the library form.
notes: The apply link is the Teen Advisory Board form. Service-hour sign-off requests go to the Teen Services Librarian and take up to 3 business days. The library cannot sign court-ordered community service.
